claims: Ripple says OCC granted final approval to charter Ripple National Trust Bank
Ripple says RNTB approved activities include managing segregated RLUSD reserves, acting as collateral trustee for RLUSD holders, and providing fiduciary digital-asset custody
RLUSD continues to be issued by Standard Custody & Trust Company, Ripple's NYDFS-regulated limited-purpose trust company
RNTB's custody services are to begin upon opening; opening date not specified
limitations: no OCC final decision document or reference number for Ripple was located in this run

OCC public Interpretations & Decisions page still displays Ripple Conditional Approval 1359 dated December 12 2025; the page says it is updated as letters are ready, so absence of a later final document is not disconfirmation
company announcement is not a substitute for the OCC's final order or proof that the bank is operational

claims: Circle announced final OCC approval to establish First National Digital Currency Bank, N.A., operating as Circle National Trust
upon opening, the trust bank will provide fiduciary digital-asset custody for Circle and affiliates
management of the USDC Reserve is described as a future capability, not an activity at initial opening
limitations: announcement does not establish that the bank has opened or begun operating
reserve management is explicitly future capability

sources.publisher: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
claims: OCC table lists Corporate Decision 1370, dated April 2 2026, as preliminary conditional approval for Coinbase National Trust Company
limitations: conditional approval is not final approval or operational authorization

sources.publisher: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
claims: OCC issued final rule implementing the GENIUS Act for payment stablecoin issuance and related activities under OCC jurisdiction
rule covers reserve assets, redemption, risk management, audits, reports, supervision, custody, applications and capital/operational backstop
effective date is January 18 2027, not November 1 2026
limitations: OCC states BSA/AML and OFAC requirements will be addressed in a separate rulemaking with Treasury
OCC says it is not yet accepting applications or waivers for permitted payment stablecoin issuers pending OMB approval of application information collection

sources.publisher: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
claims: OCC states it is not yet accepting waivers or applications from payment stablecoin issuers
OCC will announce when applications begin after OMB approval of application forms
limitations: status can change; monitor official page

sources.publisher: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
claims: page lists Ripple Conditional Approval 1359 from December 12 2025
page lists Coinbase Corporate Decision 1370 from April 2 2026
page states it is updated as letters are ready for publishing
limitations: index absence of a later Ripple final order is not conclusive evidence that no final approval occurred after the latest listed decision

comparison.ripple: company-reported final approval; claimed reserve-management and collateral-trustee authority; RNTB not confirmed operational
comparison.circle: company-reported final approval; custody for Circle and affiliates upon opening; USDC reserve management explicitly future capability
comparison.coinbase: OCC primary preliminary conditional approval; not final
comparison.warning: Do not collapse charter approval, opening, permitted stablecoin issuer status, and actual product deployment into one status.
